job.job_description:
We Are Hiring Data Scientists


NDS Infoserv Andheri (West), Mumbai | Relocation Required

NDS Infoserv has spent 20 years delivering world-class software and BPO solutions to Fortune 100 and Fortune 500 companies. Now we are scaling aggressively into Advanced AI, LLMs, and Enterprise Automation and we want top-tier Data Scientists who can build what others say is impossible.

If you want a slow, comfortable job — this is not for you.
If you want to work on frontier AI, move fast, and solve real global problems — welcome.

The Role: Build the Future of AI

At NDS Infoserv, you will be at the center of our AI expansion, building mission-critical systems in:

Healthcare AI (EHR, ICD/CPT automation, clinical NLP)


Financial AI (risk models, predictive engines)


You’ll work with:
Deep Learning, Transformers, LLMs, Agentic AI, Generative AI, Model Optimization, Multimodal Architectures — and push them beyond standard research boundaries.

We move fast. We ship fast. We expect excellence.

Your Responsibilities

Architect and deploy state-of-the-art AI/LLM models end-to-end

Breakdown huge, messy datasets into structured intelligence

Run rapid experiments with cutting-edge research papers

Push models to the limit on accuracy, performance, and scale

Work directly with leadership to integrate AI into enterprise workflows

Own your projects — no micromanagement, no handholding


If you love autonomy and speed, you’ll thrive here.

Qualifications — We’re Looking for Heavy Hitters

PhD/Master's in CS, AI, ML, or equivalent real-world depth

Strong grounding in Gen AI, LLM, Agentic AI


Hands-on proficiency with:

PyTorch / TensorFlow

Pandas, NumPy

Flask / FastAPI

Experience building and deploying real AI systems (not just notebooks)

Ability to explain complex AI in simple, powerful language

Hunger to learn, experiment, and break limits


If you want to grow slowly, look elsewhere. If you want to become a world-class AI engineer fast — join us.

What You Get

Competitive compensation with fast-track growth

Work with leadership on company-defining AI products

A culture that rewards speed, innovation, and ownership

Massive learning curve — LLMs, Generative AI, Agents, everything

The chance to build systems used by Fortune 100 clients worldwide


This is a career-defining opportunity.

Company

NDS Infoserv Pvt. Ltd.
Website: www.ndsinfo.com
Location: Andheri (West), Mumbai
Relocation required — we want our team onsite and moving fast.

Send your updated CV immediately.
